info.headline: Moderate Flood Warning for Balonne River to Surat, Balonne River at Warkon and Balonne River at Surat
info.description:
Moderate flooding is possible along the Balonne River to Surat.
The Balonne River at Warkon is currently at 5.82 m and rising, below the minor flood level. The Balonne River at Warkon is likely to exceed the minor flood level (7.00 m) Wednesday morning. The river may reach around the moderate flood level (8.00 m) Wednesday evening. Further rises are possible as upstream flows arrive.
No observations are currently available for the Balonne River at Surat. The Balonne River at Surat may exceed the minor flood level (5.00 m) Wednesday afternoon. Further rises are possible as upstream flows arrive. Forecasts will be refined as upstream peaks are observed.
info.instruction:
* Don't drive, walk, swim or play in floodwater because it is dangerous. * Stay away from flooded drains, rivers, streams and waterways. * Obey road closure signs. Plan ahead so you don't drive on flooded roads. * Check the ABC and local media for updates. The situation can change quickly, so stay informed. * For local emergency management warnings and advice visit www.disaster.qld.gov.au/warnings.
For emergency assistance call SES on telephone number 132 500. In life-threatening emergencies, call 000 (triple zero) immediately.
